g.text: 6. Pneumatic devices on a shared core
One body call per scan, at the top of the block.
The output bits are those of the previous scan, so a timeout
is reported one scan after its timer elapses. The state is
exact. Insert and retract set together cancel each other,
Library device for new work. 10 s timeout, 1 s limit switch
latch, single or double acting valve, fast fault while not
seated, test seams as properties (InsertedLS, RetractedLS,
InsertCmd, ...). CallAfterInitActuator re-wires it when nested.
Legacy MPA block of kfe and lfe, kept as it behaved: it commands
itself to match a limit switch it finds active, its fast fault
name comes from sName, its MPS rule follows the commanded
direction, 5 s timeout. CallAfterInitMPA re-wires it when nested.
